claims_supported: The issuer may elect, subject to conditions, to sell up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares to Cantor under a committed equity facility.
The prospectus uses an October 29 closing price of $14.71 and states approximately $76.8 million gross and $74.4 million net proceeds under its full-share scenario.
The contractual VWAP Purchase Price is 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to additional terms.

Proceeds may fund general corporate purposes, including XRP and other XRP-ecosystem activities, and working capital; the issuer expects a substantial portion to acquire XRP but retains broad discretion.

The prospectus discloses a $521,893.50 upfront commitment fee, an aggregate $1 million cap for upfront plus additional commitment fees, Cantor expense reimbursement capped at $500,000, and a $200,000 StoneX qualified-independent-underwriter fee plus up to $1,000 expenses.
Cantor's subsequent resale of shares is for Cantor's account; Evernorth does not receive proceeds from those resales.
limitations: The filing does not establish that the facility commenced, that Cantor purchased any shares, that cash was received under the facility, or that facility proceeds were used to purchase XRP.
The prospectus's gross/net scenario does not disclose the exact VWAP path and fee assumptions needed to reproduce the net estimate from the contractual pricing formula.
Other registration, listing, legal and accounting expenses are described but not all numerically capped in the cited sections.
This source is issuer-authored disclosure hosted by the SEC; it is not an independent corroborating publisher.

observations.claim: Evernorth has a discretionary committed equity facility for up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares to Cantor, subject to commencement and purchase conditions.
observations.detail: The issuer controls whether and when to direct purchases. The agreement is not an unconditional cash advance and the prospectus does not establish that any drawdown occurred.

observations.claim: Evernorth expects a substantial portion of any facility proceeds to be used to acquire additional XRP.
observations.detail: Proceeds are also permitted for general corporate purposes, other XRP-ecosystem activities and working capital. The issuer retains broad discretion; the statement is not evidence of a completed XRP purchase.

observations.claim: The VWAP Purchase Price is 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to the contract's additional provisions.
observations.detail: A scenario that multiplies the cover-page closing price by the full share count at 100% is not the same calculation as applying the contractual 97%-of-VWAP purchase price.

observations.claim: Using the $14.71 cover price as a proxy for VWAP produces approximately $74.467M before issuer fees at 97% pricing, leaving only about $67,418 between that amount and the stated $74.4M net estimate.
observations.detail: The same-price proxy is illustrative, not actual VWAP. The $67,418 remainder is below the disclosed $521,893.50 upfront fee plus $200,000 StoneX fee, before capped Cantor expenses and other registration costs. This flags an unreconciled scenario/fee basis; it does not establish an accounting error because the filing does not provide the exact VWAP and fee assumptions used for the net estimate.

observations.claim: The prospectus discloses up to $1M aggregate Cantor commitment fees, up to $500K Cantor/CF&CO reimbursable expenses, and a $200K StoneX fee plus up to $1K expenses.
observations.detail: These are contractual fee/expense terms and caps, not proof that every capped amount has been incurred or paid. Other registration expenses are separately described.

observations.claim: Actual facility drawdown, cash receipt and XRP purchases funded by the Cantor facility are not established by the reviewed prospectus.
observations.detail: Track capacity, issuer share issuance to Cantor, Cantor resale, issuer cash receipt and subsequent XRP acquisition as separate events. Cantor's resale proceeds do not flow to Evernorth.

competing_hypotheses.claim: If the facility is activated and shares are sold to Cantor, a substantial share of the resulting issuer cash may fund additional XRP purchases.
support: The issuer explicitly expects a substantial portion of proceeds to acquire XRP.
disconfirming_or_missing: No facility drawdown or facility-funded XRP purchase is established in the reviewed prospectus.
The issuer retains broad discretion and may use proceeds for working capital or other corporate purposes.
tests: Review subsequent 8-K/prospectus supplements for VWAP purchase notices, issued-share counts and cash receipts.
Reconcile post-facility XRP holdings and wallet transfers against the issuer's disclosed purchase dates and venues.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The facility may be used primarily for working capital and corporate expenses, with little or no incremental XRP acquisition.
support: The prospectus permits general corporate and working-capital uses and leaves allocation to the issuer.
disconfirming_or_missing: The issuer says it expects a substantial portion of proceeds to acquire XRP.
tests: Compare future use-of-proceeds disclosures, operating cash needs, share issuance and independently observed XRP holdings changes.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The facility may remain unused or only partially used if market, registration, price, volume or ownership conditions are not satisfied.
support: The issuer has the right but not the obligation to direct purchases; commencement and purchase conditions apply.
disconfirming_or_missing: Subsequent purchase notices, share issuance and issuer cash receipts would disconfirm non-use for the covered period.
tests: Monitor effectiveness/commencement notices, 8-K filings, share counts and Cantor resale prospectus supplements.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The stated $74.4M net scenario is not reproducible from the disclosed cover-price assumption, 97%-of-VWAP formula and enumerated fees without additional assumptions or clarification.
support: At a same-price VWAP proxy, 97% of the cover-price gross is about $74.467M before fees; disclosed upfront and StoneX fees alone total about $721,894 if due/paid.
disconfirming_or_missing: Actual applicable VWAP and the exact fee/expense assumptions used for the net estimate are not disclosed in the cited scenario.
tests: Seek a subsequent prospectus supplement or issuer clarification that states the assumed VWAP and fee bridge; compare with actual notices and paid fees.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Equity-line issuance and Cantor resale may affect XRPN share supply/liquidity but do not mechanically create XRP token supply or spot purchases.
support: The facility issues Evernorth Class A shares; XRP acquisition is a separate possible use of issuer cash.
disconfirming_or_missing: A disclosed and reconciled facility-funded XRP purchase would establish a separate XRP acquisition event.
tests: Track XRPN issuance/resale separately from issuer cash receipts, XRP holdings and XRPL/exchange transaction evidence.

reference_assumptions.contractual_purchase_price: 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to additional terms

derived_scenarios.calculation_note: The 97%-of-VWAP scenario assumes VWAP equals the $14.71 cover-page closing price. The $1.701M capped-fee envelope sums the $1M aggregate Cantor commitment-fee cap, $500K Cantor/CF&CO expense cap, $200K StoneX fee and $1K StoneX expense cap. It excludes other unquantified registration/listing/legal/accounting costs and is a maximum-cap sensitivity, not expected or actual fees.

fee_terms.upfront_fee_payment_timing: within five business days after the Upfront Determination Date (registration effectiveness); the filing says it is non-refundable and fully earned under the agreement.
fee_terms.other_registration_costs: registration/filing, Nasdaq listing, counsel and independent-accountant expenses are described separately; the cited sections do not provide a single aggregate cap for all such costs.

data_quality.source_independence: single issuer disclosure; SEC hosting is not an independent second publisher
data_quality.no_averaging_policy: No scenario values or fee caps are averaged; exact contractual VWAP and actual fee receipts are unknown.
limitations: The cover-page closing price is not the contractual VWAP.
The exact VWAP path and assumptions behind the stated net estimate are not disclosed in the reviewed scenario.
Fee caps are not proof of fees paid; the upfront fee and StoneX fee have separate timing/conditions.
Actual share sales, cash receipts, XRP purchases, counterparties, execution venues and wallet movements require later filings or independently captured transaction evidence.
The prospectus is issuer-authored; its statements are not independently corroborated by the same SEC-hosted document.
